<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1072
Claimant:
Colleen Black
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
4 May 2024
Claim opened following a report of a rear-end collision at a signalized intersection. The insured's vehicle was struck
from behind while stopped, and the claimant reported a right knee injury.
17 May 2024
Confirmed that the driver is named on the policy and that coverage was active at the time of loss. Assigned the file for
investigation.
3 Jun 2024
Obtained the police report, which places the claimant inside the struck vehicle at the scene. Both the reporting officer
and two independent witnesses confirm the collision happened as described.
18 Jun 2024
Reviewed photos from the scene and the other driver's statement. Both are consistent with the reported impact, and
the damage pattern on the vehicle matches a rear-end collision of this kind.
4 Jul 2024
Spoke with the claimant's attorney, who confirmed representation and asked that all contact go through their office.
Requested medical records and the treatment history for the knee.
6 Jul 2024
Received the first medical report. It describes a knee injury, but the physician has not yet stated whether it was
caused by this collision, so causation remains open.
21 Aug 2024
Took a recorded statement from the claimant through counsel. The account of the crash matches what was given to
the police and to the other driver, with no changes in any conversation.
22 Aug 2024
Contacted a neighbor who recalled seeing the vehicle with visible damage several weeks before the claimed loss
date. Noted this as an unverified recollection and planned to follow up.
22 Sep 2024
Checked prior claims and records for the claimant and the vehicle. No earlier damage to the vehicle appears in the
file, and no prior injury to the same knee has been identified.
11 Oct 2024
Reviewed the treatment billing and visit log. Treatment has run somewhat longer than is typical for this type of knee
injury, and the additional visits are being chceked against the medical notes.
15 Oct 2024
Sent the neighbor's recollection and the veihcle inspection notes to the medical reviewer and to counsel for comment.
Requested a clarification from the treating physician on the timing of onset.
14 Nov 2024
Causation of the knee injury is still unresolved pending the physician's clarification. Vehicle damage, the accident
itself, and the claimant's presence in the car are confirmed, and the file stays open for the medical review.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
